title: bibojsa: group-velocity matching and photon-pair purity in BiB3O6
description:
Python package, survey data and figure sources underlying Group-velocity-matched photon pairs in BiB3O6: a map of nondegenerate purity loci across all twelve interactions (A. Gaydardzhiev, submitted to Optics Express, 2026).

bibojsa computes collinear spontaneous parametric down-conversion in biaxial crystals: Sellmeier dispersion and group indices, biaxial phase matching from the Fresnel equation of wave normals, the full point-group-2 effective nonlinearity, classification of the group-velocity-matching conditions as level curves in pump wavelength, and the joint spectral amplitude with its Schmidt decomposition and heralded-photon purity. The repository contains the package with 108 tests, the survey scripts, the complete survey output as CSV (bibojsa/survey/: the 2193 traced GVM points of all twelve principal-plane interactions, the frequency-degenerate members, per-point purity/convergence/JSA/Schmidt/brightness tables, window and length dependence, Sellmeier sensitivity), the plot-ready slices and pgfplots sources of the five manuscript figures, and the independent-code off-principal-plane and pair-rate checks of 21 September 2026.

Code is MIT-licensed; the data files (bibojsa/survey/, manuscript/figures/data/, exploration CSVs) are released under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
